The *Catumaṭṭhajātaka* (Ja 187) is a Buddhist birth story preserved in the Jātaka collection of the Pali canon [SuttaCentral]. Translated into English by Bhikkhu Sujato as *Polished in Four Ways*, the narrative is set at Jetavana and opens with the line “Sit and sing,” told by the Buddha concerning an elder monk [SuttaCentral].
